req.title: Login case-sensitive username
req.statement: The system shall treat usernames as case-sensitive on POST /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that usernames are case-sensitive on POST /auth/login. The pre-loaded fixture has user 'test' with password 'test'. We need: (1) a positive test confirming exact-case login succeeds (EP), (2) a negative test confirming uppercase variant 'TEST' fails (NEG), (3) a boundary test confirming mixed-case 'Test' also fails (BVA/DT). Additional tests cover 'OTHER' vs 'other' and the exact error message text to kill string-mutation operators. All tests use in-process Flask test client with a fresh temp DB per test.

tests.name: test_login_exact_case_succeeds
preconditions: Database contains user with username='test' and password='test'
trace: R-FLASKR-036: exact-case username must authenticate successfully
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_login_exact_case_succeeds():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    os.unlink(path)

test_login_exact_case_succeeds()

tests.name: test_login_case_sensitive_no_session_on_wrong_case
preconditions: Database contains user with username='test' and password='test'
actions: Check that no session user_id is set (user is not logged in)
expected: HTTP 200 (login page re-rendered, not a redirect)
trace: R-FLASKR-036: alternating-case variant must not create a session
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_login_case_sensitive_no_session_on_wrong_case():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'tEsT', 'password': 'test'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess
    os.unlink(path)

test_login_case_sensitive_no_session_on_wrong_case()

from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_login_correct_case_sets_session():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

    os.unlink(path)
